commentaire: The stage 7 of the Tour of Argentina was ridden with the peloton together until the end, with no stage contention, due to the killing of Saul MORALES CORRAL (Esp) that day, a truck entering the route and fatally crashing with him. The peloton decided not to take part in the stage 8a. A a result of this, no CQ-points are awarded to the leader.
titre: Vuelta a Argentina, Stage 7 : Encon - San Juan (160 km)
